insight: Bootstrapped to roughly $8M ARR by Paris founder David Zitoun with a tiny team and no VC funding.
name: Submagic
tagline: Edit short-form videos 10x faster with AI.
description: AI video editor for short-form content that auto-generates captions in dozens of languages, removes silences, inserts B-roll, and extracts the highest-engagement clips from long videos. Upload footage or a YouTube link and get TikTok/Reels/Shorts-ready edits. Pricing is per finished video rather than per credit.
edge: Billed per finished video, not per credit or source-minute, and auto-inserts context-matched B-roll, not just captions.
